Save the video, not the popups

A Safari extension • by Luna Downloader

Download videos in one tap. Watch anything with no account and no app download. Downloads go right to your Photos app, ready to share. Don't worry. All your data is offline. There are no Luna servers to send anything to.

Turn it on in Safari

  1. Tap the page menu in the address bar
  2. Choose “Manage Extensions”
  3. Switch on Luna Downloader
  4. Select Allow on all websites

Your browsing history and data is kept entirely on device. Luna works on your phone to improve your browsing experience and let you retrieve your own history locally.
